newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Pulp and Paper unit completes yen FRN.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp and Paper unit completes yen FRN.

text.p: Asia Pulp and Paper Co unit APP International Finance Co BV's 11 billion Euro-yen guaranteed floating rate note issue has been closed, lead manager Peregrine Fixed Income said on Monday.
The notes mature in December 1999 but can be put annually. They were issued and re-offered at par to float at 150 basis points over the 12-month Japanese yen London Interbank Offered Rate.
The notes are issued under the borrower's US$1.0 billion Guaranteed Asian Currency Notes Programme.
Lead managers are Peregrine Fixed Income, Fuji International Finance (HK), IBJ Asia and Yamaichi Merchant Bank (Singapore).
The notes are now free to trade.
Signing is set for December 6 in Singapore.
